summary: The comments emphasize the importance of preserving E-Rate funding to ensure proper infrastructure maintenance and avoid increased security vulnerabilities and network instability. The comments highlight the critical role of E-Rate in supporting schools and libraries and urge the FCC to preserve its core funding and avoid changes that would reduce access or increase burden for students and communities.

claims.argument: Without this funding, key infrastructure would not be properly maintained/upgraded/replaced when needed
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, key infrastructure would not be properly maintained/upgraded/replaced when needed. This can lead to increased security vulnerability as well as network instability across the board. In my time in this field, schools have heavily leaned on E-Rate funding to maintain and upgrade necessary infrastructure, so much so that our replacement cycles now match E-Rate funding cycles.
